value.rationale: This is an exact, natural complete relative FO-depth classification of the classical exceptional strongly regular parameter class. Unlike a bare table of induced subgraphs, it shows the qualitative rank-3-to-rank-4 logical transition and two explicit missing-extension obstructions separating Chang graphs despite the presence of every induced four-vertex shape in each. The contrast with the restricted four-existential-prefix fragment gives an interpretable structural explanation.
